name: Baron Aquanis
label: Quest
description: Upon vanquishing the water elemental Baron Aquanis within Blackfathom Deeps, adventurers recover a Strange Water Globe containing tainted, putrid fluid.…
intro: Upon vanquishing the water elemental Baron Aquanis within Blackfathom Deeps, adventurers recover a Strange Water Globe containing tainted, putrid fluid. Brought to Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring, the artifact provides crucial evidence of the elemental corruption spreading beneath Ashenvale. Je'neu believes it will prove what corrupted the baron, and he wouldn't be surprised if it were the Twilight's Hammer cultists lurking in the submerged ruins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe. You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy. Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about. The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.
If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring. He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, hello again friend. I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do. What brings you to the outpost?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This... This is quite the find, friend.

You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say? Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him. While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.
You did well in bringing this to me. Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.
